purpose: Express an intense feeling, sensation, or desire.
keywords: express wishes wants obligation permission request advice
express feelings speak politely show respect
Vて / い-adjectiveくて / な-adjectiveで + たまらない
I am desperate to know the result.
I am incredibly happy that we can finally meet again.
formation: Vて / い-adjectiveくて / な-adjectiveで + たまらない
restrictions: Often conveys something hard to bear because of its intensity.
mistake: This is intensity, not a prohibition.
